title: Rory and the Whispering Stream
verses:
When the sun drifted down in the shadow of trees,
And a murmur was borne on the lullaby breeze,
Rory walked through the fern on a path made of moss,
Where the shadowy pine branches tilted across.

Then Nia flew down from the canopy high,
While Psittaco chirped at a cloud in the sky.
They had followed the hum of a soft gentle stream,
Where the waters were bright with a silver-white gleam.

Now Benny sat down where the reeds gently sway,
To welcome the night at the end of the day.
And Ricky curled up by a smooth river stone,
So happy to know he was never alone.

Then Tilly tucked in with a satisfied sigh,
As the stars started twinkling way up in the sky.
And Psittaco nestled right under her crest,
For everyone knew it was time for a rest.

High up in the branches, Nia folded her wings,
And listened to songs that the cool river sings.
While Rory gave everyone one final smile,
And lay by his friends in the moss for a while.

The forest was quiet, the dark sky was deep,
And all of the dinos were falling asleep.
So close your sweet eyes as the soft breezes blow,
And dream gentle dreams in the evening's warm glow.
